_comments._source: Every content-shaped number from docs/02-game-design.md's 'Appendix: tuning defaults index', plus the section tables it points at. All numbers are tunable defaults (docs/02 preamble); the table wins over prose.
_comments.clock: docs/02 §4.1 — in-game day 20 real min (1 hr = 50s); phases MORN/DAY/EVE/LATE with hour bounds verbatim from docs/03's enum; MUST mirror sim/clock.ts PHASE_BOUNDS (unit-tested); forced sleep 3a (hardSleepMin 180), wake 6a; LATE runs 4x slower inside SOCIAL/ROMANCE venues => lateVenueTimeScale 0.25.
_comments.combat: docs/02 §1.1 (fight length), §1.2 (buffer/dead zone/hold/auto-facing), §1.3 (chain, launcher, juggle, throw, environmental, signature frame), §1.4 (stamina/power economies, second wind), §1.5 (enemy archetypes, tokens, crowd budget), §1.6 (ramp caps, grunt hit 12%, Splash Rating, rubber-band). Damage unit anchor: one light hit = 100.
_comments.machines: docs/02 §1.9 — CIVIS family HP mults, flagged +20%, Detainer 20s rescue / 30% carry slow, swarm groups 5-8, scrap 2-5/unit, Warden-hand drops (5 flux cells + 12-20 scrap, cap 1/mission), Demolition Rating x1.0-1.5, machines immune to Fear (quirk 4).
_comments.anchor: docs/02 §1.8 + appendix — Slot Zero + 1 free slot at start -> 3 free late (displays 2 -> 4); reservation 25%/free thread -> 20% via tree (Slot Zero reserves NONE); ignite 20 power, drop free; palette hold >=300ms at 0.3x time max 4s; fidelity 60/80/100% at bond 2 / 3-4 / 5, cap 120%; Full Hands 5s at 100 power. MUST equal heroes/anchor.json kit — unit test enforces no drift.
_comments.progression: docs/02 §2.1 (3 branches x 7 nodes; cost(n) = base x 1.5^n, cash base 100 / flux base 7, n = 0..6, rounded to nearest int; respec: Utility free, Power/Signature refund 25% of spent flux), §2.2 (levels 1-30, node tier gates at Lv1/10/20; combat XP 100/70/20), §2.3 (rep tiers 0/500/1500/3500/7000, 1-indexed).
_comments.relationships: docs/02 §5.1 (axes -100..100, confession/intimidation gates), §5.2 (tracks 0-5, gift soft cap 2/NPC/day), §5.4 (needs buff-only at >=60), §5.5 + docs/04 §6 (gossip juice multipliers; PROTECTED: corridor fear gets NO juice multiplier — grief-class handling), §9.3 (Dread aura at Fear >=50 district sample).
_comments.zone: docs/02 §8.1 (6 segments, patrol density 0-3, BLIND -50% for 1 day / relays rebuild in 2), §8.3 (mutation every 3 in-game days, 12-entry comedic deck, M1-M6 scheduled story pulls consume their cycle), §9.2 (FIVE reveal stages — canon docs/09 §5; injected items at stages 1/3/5: fidelity 1.0, 2 hops/sleep, half decay; Stage-2 leak fidelity 0.7), §8.2/§10 (2 SIEGEs, 3 min hard cap).
_comments.base: docs/02 §3.1 (8 fixed slots: 4 at unlock + 2 at rep tier 2 + 1 + 1 at tiers 3-4; no duplicate room types in slice), §3.4 (8 followers max, missions 2-4 REAL hours — the only real-time system, party 1-3).
_comments.farm: docs/02 §4.2 (daily upkeep <=60s, crops pause when unwatered — never wilt) and §3.2 (flux plot hard cap 4 at every greenhouse level — parity rule §2.4).
_comments.save: docs/02 §7.3 — save size budget <=2MB, single slot + 3 rolling backups.
